title: Settlement Basis for Air Ticket Fare Brands: Value Placed on a Travel Credit Voucher
content:
Under the Air Ticket Fare Brands terms, the value placed on the voucher is the fare, tax and service lines collected on the booking, less the money already returned to the original form of payment, less the agency service fee retained, and less the whole of the penalty standing on the booking, and is never below zero. The agency service fee retained is the agency service fee of the fare brand held, taken once.

**The quantities, and where each is read on the booking.**

| Quantity | How it is read |
| --- | --- |
| The fare, tax and service lines collected on the booking | The total of the fare lines, the tax lines and the service lines posted on that booking, and of no other line posted on it |
| The money already returned to the original form of payment | The total of the payout lines standing on the booking for taxes and carrier fees returned by the airline, taken as a positive amount |
| The agency service fee retained | The agency service fee of the fare brand held, taken once |
| The penalty standing on the booking | The total of the withheld penalty lines standing on the booking |

**The stage, and how the result follows from it.** The three deductions are taken from the fare, tax and service lines collected on the booking; where together they come to more than those lines, the figure reached is zero, that figure never falling below zero. The figure so reached is the value the booking's lines leave. The value the booking's lines leave is settled first, and the value placed on the voucher is that figure once every share and every uplift that bears on it has been taken, each share and each uplift acting in turn on the figure the one before it gives, so that the figure runs on from one step to the next and is never reached by measuring them separately against the value the booking's lines leave and netting the results together. The value placed on the voucher is rounded to two decimal places at the end and never at any intermediate step.

**How several act on one figure.** Where more than one share is taken on the same figure, the shares act one after another, each on the figure the one before it gives, and are never combined into a single rate; where more than one uplift is added to the same figure, the uplifts are combined into a single uplift and the figure is increased once by that total.

**Against what the voucher is raised.** The voucher is issued against the booking whose ticket produced it and carries an expiry set by the credit validity term of the fare brand that produced it. The issue line is filed against the base-fare line posted earliest on the booking and carries the traveller position of that line.

**A worked determination on hypothetical figures.** Every figure and every rate in what follows is hypothetical, chosen only to show the whole chain being carried, and no rate below is a published one. Fare, tax and service lines collected on the booking, 1420.00 US dollars; money already returned to the original form of payment, 96.40 US dollars; agency service fee retained, 24.00 US dollars; penalty standing on the booking, 180.00 US dollars. The money collected less the money already returned is 1323.60; less the agency service fee retained, 1299.60; less the whole of the penalty standing on the booking, 1119.60. On those hypothetical figures the value the booking's lines leave is settled at 1119.60 US dollars, and the value placed on the voucher follows from that settled figure. Suppose a share of 0.64 bears on it: 1119.60 taken at 0.64 gives 716.544. Suppose an uplift of 0.37 then bears on the figure that share gave: 716.544 increased by 0.37 gives 981.66528. Suppose a share of 0.72 then bears on the figure that uplift gave: 981.66528 taken at 0.72 gives 706.7990016. Each step is worked on the figure the step before it gave, and no step is worked on the 1119.60 the stage settled at. The figure so carried is above zero, so the rule that it is never below zero leaves it as it stands, and rounded to two decimal places at the end the value placed on the voucher is 706.80 US dollars. On a second hypothetical booking, where 200.00 US dollars was collected and the three deductions come together to 260.00 US dollars, the value the booking's lines leave is 0.00 US dollars, and a figure of zero carried through the same hypothetical share and uplift is still 0.00 US dollars.
